description: Engine behaviour: rules, checks, repeats, pages, edit mode and output. Cases mirror engine.spec.ts and edge cases from the other specs.

cases.name: shows a field only when its rule holds, and leaves hidden answers out of the data

keeps repeat entries as an array of objects, with per-entry rules and a total
opens saved answers for editing: old keys, unknown keys and untouched hidden answers survive
lists changes made while editing
follows page jumps forward and skips the pages in between
a jump to the end skips every later page
sets a value when a condition becomes true, but not on load
a set-value rule can copy another answer, and chains settle
submits the form id, revision and data

keeps hidden answers when the form says never clear them

cases.name: required yes/no fields and question labels word their messages
disabled and read-only fields skip checks; a disabled section disables its fields
